sources.title: Jeskai Source Ledger
sources.author: Vox Mana research packet
sources.notes: Defines Jeskai source tiers, approved use, support-only Commander limits, seed-file handling, Ojutai boundaries, and modern Dragonstorm timeline limits. It shapes this packet but does not back raw claims by itself.

sources.title: Jeskai Evidence Ledger
sources.author: Vox Mana research packet
sources.notes: Primary normalized evidence row index for VM-232 raw claims. Commander/operator rows, manual-fill rows, source rows, discovery-only seed rows, and Vox Mana synthesis rows are not raw-claim rows. JESKAI-EVID-022 is used only for lifecycle and boundary claims.

sources.title: Jeskai: Smart Thinking
sources.author: Mark Rosewater
sources.publication_date: Local capture, original date not restated in VM-229 packet

sources.title: VM-234 - Jeskai Way Controlled Runtime Promotion
sources.author: Vox Mana project card
sources.notes: Used only to resolve live/generated lifecycle metadata after the VM-232 source packet and VM-233 review gate. It is not lore evidence, card evidence, Commander evidence, or support for color-code public aliases.

sources.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Khans of Tarkir, Part 1

sources.publication_date: Local capture, original date not restated in VM-229 packet

sources.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged

sources.title: Khanfall
